parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Singleton planning horizon with one period

parameters.name: product_lengths
parameters.description: Required cut length for each product type

parameters.name: demands
parameters.description: Demand quantity for each product type

parameters.name: pipe_length
parameters.description: Length of one raw steel pipe

parameters.name: unit_pipe_cost
parameters.description: Unit purchase value of one raw pipe

parameters.name: max_distinct_patterns
parameters.description: Maximum number of distinct cutting patterns allowed

parameters.name: max_pieces_per_pipe
parameters.description: Maximum number of pieces allowed from one raw pipe under any pattern

parameters.name: max_leftover_length
parameters.description: Maximum allowed leftover length for any pattern

parameters.name: rank_surcharge_multipliers
parameters.description: Surcharge multiplier for each usage rank

variables.name: select_pattern
variables.description: Binary selection variable indicating whether cutting pattern k is selected

variables.name: pieces_per_pattern_product
variables.description: Nonnegative integer number of pieces of product type p cut from one raw pipe under pattern k

variables.name: pipes_assigned_to_pattern
variables.description: Nonnegative integer number of raw pipes assigned to pattern k

variables.name: pattern_usage_rank
variables.description: Integer usage rank of selected pattern k, ordered from most frequently used to least frequently used

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_pieces
constraints.description: Pieces per pattern-product are nonnegative integers

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_pipes
constraints.description: Pipes assigned to each pattern are nonnegative integers

constraints.name: integer_pattern_rank
constraints.description: Pattern usage rank is an integer value

constraints.name: demand_satisfaction
constraints.description: The cutting plan must satisfy customer demand for every product type

constraints.name: max_distinct_patterns
constraints.description: The number of selected cutting patterns cannot exceed the allowed maximum

constraints.name: max_pieces_per_pipe
constraints.description: For any selected pattern, the total number of pieces cut from one raw pipe cannot exceed the maximum allowed

constraints.name: max_leftover_length
constraints.description: For any selected pattern, the leftover length from one raw pipe cannot exceed the maximum allowed

constraints.name: exactly_one_pattern_per_pipe
constraints.description: Each raw pipe is assigned to exactly one cutting pattern; in aggregate form this means every assigned pipe is counted through exactly one pattern variable

constraints.name: pattern_frequency_ranking
constraints.description: Selected patterns are ordered from most frequently used to least frequently used, and rank-based surcharge multipliers are applied according to that order
constraints.formula: n_i - n_j \geq 1 - K^{\max}(1-z_{ij}) \quad \forall i,j \in \mathcal{K},\ i<j;\qquad r_i + 1 \leq r_j + K^{\max}(1-z_{ij}) \quad \forall i,j \in \mathcal{K},\ i<j

constraints.name: raw_pipe_cut_length_limit
constraints.description: The total cut length in any pattern cannot exceed the raw pipe length

constraints.name: pattern_selection_linking
constraints.description: A pattern is selected if and only if it is used; this links binary selection to positive pipe assignment.

constraints.name: pattern_count_upper_bound
constraints.description: Each selected pattern corresponds to at least one assigned pipe and the number of selected patterns cannot exceed the maximum allowed

constraints.name: pattern_rank_domain_bounds
constraints.description: Ranks are restricted to the available rank positions for selected patterns

constraints.name: pairwise_rank_ordering
constraints.description: If pattern i is used more frequently than pattern j, then i must receive a better or equal rank than j; this enforces a consistent frequency ordering across selected patterns

constraints.name: rank_tie_handling
constraints.description: Ties in pipe counts are allowed and do not force a strict rank separation
constraints.formula: n_i - n_j \leq K^{\max} z_{ij} \quad \forall i,j \in \mathcal{K},\ i<j

objectives.name: total_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total cutting-plan cost, including raw pipe purchase cost and rank-based pattern-frequency surcharges

final_objective.description: Minimize total cost consisting of raw pipe purchase cost plus rank-based surcharge applied to each selected cutting pattern according to its usage rank. The objective remains a single minimization objective, with the rank-based surcharge indexed by the modeled rank variable.
